fraction-comparison.name: Comparing Unit Fractions
fraction-comparison.description: Comparing unit fractions like 1/4 and 1/8 using visual and numerical models
fraction-comparison.rootCauseAdvice: Check whether the child visualises fractions as slices of a whole cake or as standalone whole numbers.

fraction-equal-parts.name: Fractions as Equal Parts of a Whole
fraction-equal-parts.description: Recognising that fractions require equal-sized divisions
fraction-equal-parts.rootCauseAdvice: Use hands-on folding of paper strips into halves and quarters.

division-sharing.name: Equal Sharing & Grouping
division-sharing.description: Understanding sharing items equally into groups
division-sharing.rootCauseAdvice: Physical sharing with counters, stones, or pasta shells at home.

shape-partitioning.name: 2D Shape Partitioning
shape-partitioning.description: Cutting shapes into 2 or 4 equal pieces
shape-partitioning.rootCauseAdvice: Drawing mirror lines and cutting paper sandwiches.

place-value-3digit.name: 3-Digit Place Value & Decomposition
place-value-3digit.description: Understanding hundreds, tens, and ones in numbers up to 1000
place-value-3digit.rootCauseAdvice: Base-10 block building and expanded notation cards (e.g. 300 + 40 + 5).

place-value-2digit.name: 2-Digit Place Value
place-value-2digit.rootCauseAdvice: Bundling ten sticks with elastic bands.

subtraction-regrouping.name: Subtraction with Regrouping (Exchanging)
subtraction-regrouping.description: Subtracting 2-digit and 3-digit numbers requiring exchange across tens
subtraction-regrouping.rootCauseAdvice: Physically exchanging one 10-rod for ten unit cubes before subtracting.

subtraction-without-regrouping.name: Basic Subtraction & Difference
subtraction-without-regrouping.rootCauseAdvice: Walking backward along a chalk number line.

multiplication-arrays.name: Multiplication as Equal Arrays
multiplication-arrays.description: Recognising 3 groups of 4 as an array and related to repeated addition
multiplication-arrays.rootCauseAdvice: Arranging muffin tins, egg boxes, or LEGO pegs in neat grid rows.

perimeter-measurement.name: Perimeter of Rectilinear Shapes
perimeter-measurement.rootCauseAdvice: Tracing around objects with a piece of string, then measuring the string against a ruler.

clock-time-intervals.name: Time to 5 Minutes & Intervals
clock-time-intervals.description: Reading analogue clock to 5 minutes and calculating simple elapsed time
clock-time-intervals.rootCauseAdvice: Real analogue clock play with separate hour and minute hands.
